english: Then this is your shift: today’s chair, your next customer, and how your week is going. We remember your choice.
translation: Imbagħad hawn issib ix-xift tiegħek: is-siġġu ta' llum, il-klijent li jmiss, u kif sejra l-ġimgħa tiegħek. Niftakru l-għażla tiegħek.

english: Holiday, sick days and contract hours are managed by the shop under
translation: Btajjel, mard u sigħat tal-kuntratt jiġu ġestiti mill-ħanut taħt

english: Deposits, card or pay-at-salon, weekly payouts.
translation: Depożiti, karta jew ħlas fis-salun, ħlasijiet ta' kull ġimgħa.

english: Pay online or at the salon. Reminders and directions included.
translation: Ħallas online jew fis-salun. Tfakkiriet u direzzjonijiet inklużi.

english: Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay — or simply pay at the salon.
translation: Karta, Apple Pay, Google Pay — jew sempliċement ħallas fis-salun.

english: Patch tests, consent and allergy notes handled before you arrive.
translation: Testijiet tal-ġilda, kunsens u noti dwar allerġiji jiġu mmaniġġjati qabel ma tasal.

english: Calendar, payments, team rota, stock and loyalty — one app, no setup fee.
translation: Kalendarju, ħlasijiet, rota tat-tim, stokk u lealtà — app waħda, mingħajr spiża ta' setup.

english: Uses your taste profile (consent — GDPR Art. 22 explainable)
translation: Juża l-profil tal-gosti tiegħek (kunsens — GDPR Art. 22 spjegabbli)

english: Rest is paid at the shop

ai_review_note: pm_saved: third person 'iħallas' changed to second person 'tħallas' to address the payer.

english: This card number does not check out — please re-check it.
translation: Dan in-numru tal-karta mhuwiex validu — jekk jogħġbok erġa' ċċekkjah.

english: By confirming you authorize StyleNow Demo to collect this amount by SEPA direct debit (demo mandate).
translation: Bil-konferma tawtorizza lil StyleNow Demo jiġbor dan l-ammont permezz ta' debitu dirett SEPA (mandat demo).

english: Demo checkout — no real charge is made and nothing you type leaves your browser. Only a masked label like “Visa ····4242” is kept.
translation: Checkout demo — ma jittieħed l-ebda ħlas reali u xejn minn dak li tikteb ma jitlaq mill-browser tiegħek. Tinżamm biss tikketta moħbija bħal “Visa ····4242”.

english: Your whole configuration — team, hours, menu, rules, photos, billing, customer notes — as one JSON file you own. Download it before big changes; restore it if anything goes wrong.
translation: Il-konfigurazzjoni sħiħa tiegħek — tim, sigħat, menu, regoli, ritratti, fatturazzjoni, noti tal-klijenti — bħala fajl JSON wieħed li hu tiegħek. Niżżlu qabel bidliet kbar; irrestawrah jekk xi ħaġa tmur ħażin.

english: Tap an appointment to reschedule it, message the customer, or settle it.
translation: Missu appuntament biex terġa' tiskeduljah, tibgħat messaġġ lill-klijent, jew tiffinalizzah.

english: Pick a range — the chart shows the trend, the panels split it by service, team member and payment method.
translation: Agħżel firxa — il-graff juri x-xejra, il-pannelli jaqsmuha skont is-servizz, il-membru tat-tim u l-metodu tal-ħlas.

english: Gift cards sold show their outstanding balance — money received for work not yet delivered.
translation: Il-gift cards mibjugħa juru l-bilanċ pendenti tagħhom — flus riċevuti għal xogħol li għadu ma ngħatax.

english: The note field is yours alone — customers never see it.
translation: Il-qasam tan-noti huwa tiegħek biss — il-klijenti qatt ma jarawh.

english: Open a row to jump straight into that customer’s message thread.
translation: Iftaħ ringiela biex taqbeż direttament fil-konversazzjoni ta' dak il-klijent.

english: Every customer conversation for this shop, in one place.
translation: Kull konversazzjoni tal-klijenti għal dan il-ħanut, f'post wieħed.

english: “Can I move my appointment?” usually answers itself — customers can move bookings from their side.
translation: “Nista' nbiddel l-appuntament tiegħi?” normalment iwieġeb waħdu — il-klijenti jistgħu jbiddlu l-ibbukkjar min-naħa tagħhom.

english: Roles, branches and weekly hours — the roster here is exactly what customers can book.
translation: Rwoli, fergħat u sigħat ta' kull ġimgħa — ir-rota hawn hija eżattament dak li l-klijenti jistgħu jibbukkjaw.

english: Removing someone who still has booked customers opens a resolver first — nobody gets stranded.
translation: It-tneħħija ta' xi ħadd li għad għandu klijenti ibbukkjati tiftaħ riżolutur l-ewwel — ħadd ma jibqa' mingħajr għajnuna.

english: Approving leave lists every booked visit inside it, each one a tap to reassign or refund.
translation: L-approvazzjoni tal-leave telenka kull żjara ibbukkjata fih, kull waħda tap biex terġa' tassenja jew tirrimborża.

english: Billing details feed every receipt and e-invoice the shop issues.
translation: Id-dettalji tal-fatturazzjoni jmorru f'kull riċevuta u e-fattura li joħroġ il-ħanut.

english: Redeem at checkout — enter the code in the voucher field
translation: Uża fil-ħlas — daħħal il-kodiċi fil-qasam tal-vawċer

english: Redeem it at checkout on StyleNow — enter the code in the voucher field when booking at {shop}.
translation: Uża fil-ħlas fuq StyleNow — daħħal il-kodiċi fil-qasam tal-vawċer meta tibbukkja f'{shop}.

english: This gift card has been fully used.
Bought on this device. The recipient just needs the code — it works in the voucher field at checkout.
translation: Mixtrija fuq dan l-apparat. Ir-riċevitur jeħtieġ biss il-kodiċi — jaħdem fil-qasam tal-vawċer fil-ħlas.

english: A gift card in two minutes — printable, mailable, redeemable at checkout.
translation: Gift card f'żewġ minuti — stampabbli, jintbagħat bl-email, użabbli fil-ħlas.

english: Outstanding balances are money received for services not yet delivered — a liability until redeemed.
translation: Il-bilanċi pendenti huma flus riċevuti għal servizzi li għadhom ma ngħatawx — obbligu sakemm jintużaw.

english: {have} of {need} stamps — a full card makes the next visit free
translation: {have} minn {need} timbri — karta mimlija tagħmel iż-żjara li jmiss b'xejn

english: Your loyalty program, funded by you: {n} completed visits within six months and the next one is free. Stamps and rewards are counted from real bookings — nothing to stamp by hand, nothing to forge.
translation: Il-programm tal-lealtà tiegħek, iffinanzjat minnek: {n} żjarat komplete fi żmien sitt xhur u li jmiss hu b'xejn. It-timbri u l-premjijiet jingħaddu mill-ibbukkjar reali — xejn x'tittimbra bl-idejn, xejn x'tiffalsifika.

english: A discount that only applies in your two emptiest day-parts of the last 30 days. Those times carry a badge, so customers see why they’re cheaper.
translation: Skont li japplika biss fiż-żewġ partijiet tal-jum l-aktar vojta fl-aħħar 30 jum. Dawk il-ħinijiet għandhom badge, biex il-klijenti jaraw għaliex huma irħas.

english: Your data lives in this browser. Take it with you, or blank the personal parts in place.
translation: Id-data tiegħek tgħix f'dan il-browser. Ħudha miegħek, jew ħassar il-partijiet personali fuq il-post.

english: Blanks your name, phone, notes, memos and message texts everywhere. Amounts and dates stay, so the salons’ books still add up. Cannot be undone.
translation: Iħassar ismek, telefon, noti, memos u testi tal-messaġġi kullimkien. L-ammonti u d-dati jibqgħu, biex il-kotba tas-saluni xorta jaqblu. Ma jistax jiġi mreġġa' lura.
l-ebda kanċellazzjoni min-naħa tal-ħanut f'90 jum

english: {n}× cancelled, {m}× moved late by the salon (90 days)
Late cancel or move by the salon? A €5 sorry-voucher is issued automatically.
translation: Kanċellazzjoni jew bidla tard mis-salun? Vawċer ta' skuża ta' €5 joħroġ awtomatikament.

english: What the next shift must know…
translation: Dak li x-xift li jmiss irid ikun jaf…

english: Completed service revenue per stylist × their percent (set in the team editor). Tips are listed, never commissioned.
translation: Dħul minn servizzi mitmuma għal kull stilista × il-persentaġġ tagħhom (stabbilit fl-editur tat-tim). It-tips jidhru f'lista, qatt ma jingħataw kummissjoni.

english: This service involves colour chemistry and I have no recent patch test here. I understand the salon may do a quick test first or decline the treatment.
translation: Dan is-servizz jinvolvi kimika tal-kulur u m'għandix test tal-ġilda reċenti hawn. Nifhem li s-salun jista' jagħmel test fil-għaġla qabel jew jirrifjuta t-trattament.

english: Patch test was done — remember it
Patch test recorded for this salon (valid 6 months)
translation: Test tal-ġilda rreġistrat għal dan is-salun (validu 6 xhur)

english: No recent patch test on record for this customer
translation: Ebda test tal-ġilda reċenti rreġistrat għal dan il-klijent

english: N visits of one service for a bundle price, paid up front. Uses are counted from real bookings — a card cannot be over-spent, and a cancellation returns the use automatically.
translation: N żjarat ta' servizz wieħed bi prezz ta' pakkett, imħallsa minn qabel. L-użi jingħaddu mill-ibbukkjar reali — karta ma tistax tintefaq iżjed minn kemm hemm, u kanċellazzjoni tirritorna l-użu awtomatikament.

english: {sold} sold · {uses} visits outstanding · {eur} of prepaid work open
translation: {sold} mibjugħin · {uses} żjarat pendenti · {eur} ta' xogħol imħallas minn qabel miftuħ

english: Pay once, come back on your terms.
translation: Ħallas darba, ejja lura kif tixtieq.

english: Gift cards in bulk for your team or clients — one order, one invoice, a volume discount from 5 cards (5 %), 10 (10 %) or 20 (15 %). Every code redeems at full face value.
translation: Gift cards bl-ingrossa għat-tim jew għall-klijenti tiegħek — ordni waħda, fattura waħda, skont fuq il-volum minn 5 karti (5 %), 10 (10 %) jew 20 (15 %). Kull kodiċi jintuża bil-valur sħiħ.

english: Hand one code to each person — every code is an ordinary gift card at full face value, redeemable in the booking checkout.
translation: Agħti kodiċi wieħed lil kull persuna — kull kodiċi huwa gift card ordinarja bil-valur sħiħ, użabbli fil-ħlas tal-ibbukkjar.

english: The payment page could not be opened just now. Your seat is still held — try again in a moment.
translation: Il-paġna tal-ħlas ma setgħetx tinfetaħ issa. Is-siġġu tiegħek għadu miżmum — erġa' pprova f'mument.

english: Let guests settle at the counter — card or cash — instead of paying when they book. A deposit, where one is set, is still taken online: that is what holds the seat.
translation: Ħalli lill-klijenti jħallsu fil-bank — karta jew flus kontanti — minflok meta jibbukkjaw. Depożitu, fejn ikun stabbilit, jittieħed xorta online: dak hu li jżomm is-siġġu.

english: Guests may pay at the salon
When would you like to pay?
Nothing is charged now. {amount} is due at the counter — card or cash, whichever suits.
translation: Ma jittieħed xejn issa. {amount} huwa dovut fil-bank — karta jew flus kontanti, kif jgħaddi aħjar.

english: Signed before the seat is held, for colour and needle work. Leave empty to ask for nothing. The wording is stored with the booking exactly as it stood when it was signed.
translation: Iffirmat qabel ma jinżamm is-siġġu, għall-kulur u x-xogħol bil-labar. Ħallih vojt biex ma titlob xejn. Il-kliem jinħażen mal-ibbukkjar eżattament kif kien meta ġie ffirmat.

english: I confirm I have no known allergy to the products named, and that I understand the result depends on my hair’s condition…
translation: Nikkonferma li m'għandi l-ebda allerġija magħrufa għall-prodotti msemmija, u li nifhem li r-riżultat jiddependi mill-kundizzjoni ta' xagħri…

english: Type your full name to sign
The last 90 days, from the reason people gave at the cancel. One is an anecdote; a pattern is a roster decision.
translation: L-aħħar 90 jum, mir-raġuni li taw in-nies meta kkanċellaw. Waħda hija anekdota; xejra hija deċiżjoni dwar ir-rota.

english: Customer announced they are about {n} min late
translation: Il-klijent ħabbar li huwa madwar {n} min tard

english: Withdrawn — the salon expects you on time.
Could not tell the salon — the thread is the reliable door.
translation: Ma stajniex ngħidu lis-salun — il-konversazzjoni hija t-triq affidabbli.

english: Custom work has no fixed menu price. Describe what you have in mind and the answer lands in your messages — no booking needed first.
translation: Xogħol personalizzat m'għandux prezz fiss fil-menu. Iddeskrivi dak li għandek f'moħħok u t-tweġiba tasal fil-messaġġi tiegħek — m'hemmx bżonn ibbukkjar l-ewwel.

english: A flat monthly fee for a standing discount on every visit. Recurring revenue for you, a reason to stop shopping around for them. (Demo: the fee is simulated, no money moves.)
translation: Miżata fissa ta' kull xahar għal skont permanenti fuq kull żjara. Dħul regolari għalik, raġuni biex ma jibqgħux ifittxu x'imkien ieħor. (Demo: il-miżata hija simulata, ma jiċċaqlaq l-ebda flus.)

english: Travels with this device, fills itself into every booking, and disappears with “erase my data”.
translation: Jivvjaġġa ma' dan l-apparat, jimtela waħdu f'kull ibbukkjar, u jisparixxi b'“ħassar id-data tiegħi”.

english: Only promise what the premises actually have — customers plan their trip around this.
translation: Wegħed biss dak li l-post verament għandu — il-klijenti jippjanaw il-vjaġġ tagħhom madwar dan.

english: Customers who saved their birthday get this discount automatically in the two weeks around it — a guaranteed annual visit occasion.
translation: Klijenti li ħażnu għeluq snienhom jieħdu dan l-iskont awtomatikament fiż-żewġ ġimgħat madwaru — okkażjoni garantita ta' żjara annwali.
Vawċer ta' rieda tajba ta' €5 maħruġ
ai_review_note: dq_res_goodwill: unnatural 'ta' tajjeb' replaced by standard 'rieda tajba' (goodwill).

english: Colour service: first colour visit here? A patch test 48 h ahead is recommended — just message the salon.
translation: Servizz tal-kulur: l-ewwel żjara tal-kulur hawn? Test tal-ġilda 48 siegħa qabel huwa rakkomandat — ibgħat messaġġ lis-salun biss.

english: Sell a gift card at the counter
Gift card created — hand over the code
Share your code. Your friend gets €5 off their first booking over €25 — and the moment it confirms, a €5 gift card lands on your account.
translation: Aqsam il-kodiċi tiegħek. Il-ħabib tiegħek jieħu €5 skont fuq l-ewwel ibbukkjar tiegħu ta' aktar minn €25 — u hekk kif jikkonferma, gift card ta' €5 tasal fuq il-kont tiegħek.

english: This treatment needs a signed consent, and there is only one consent field for the whole party — book each chair separately instead.
translation: Dan it-trattament jeħtieġ kunsens iffirmat, u hemm qasam wieħed biss tal-kunsens għall-grupp kollu — ibbukkja kull siġġu separatament minflok.

english: The day’s money in one printable sheet — revenue, VAT, tips, fees, refunds, and the split by payment method. Derived live from the calendar, so it can never disagree with it.
translation: Il-flus tal-jum f'folja waħda stampabbli — dħul, VAT, tips, miżati, rimborsi, u t-tqassim skont il-metodu tal-ħlas. Derivat dirett mill-kalendarju, għalhekk qatt ma jista' ma jaqbilx miegħu.

english: Derived from the day’s bookings at the moment of opening. Demo report — not a fiscal document (no TSE signature).
translation: Derivat mill-ibbukkjar tal-jum fil-mument tal-ftuħ. Rapport demo — mhux dokument fiskali (l-ebda firma TSE).

english: Seat reserved — finish payment to keep it.
translation: Siġġu riżervat — spiċċa l-ħlas biex iżommu.

english: That time was just taken. Here are the nearest free alternatives:
translation: Dak il-ħin ġie kemm kemm meħud. Hawn l-eqreb alternattivi vojta:

english: ✅ Cancelled in time — {refund} refunded in full.
Surge is capped at +25 % platform-wide and never hits returning customers on repeat services.
translation: Iż-żieda hija limitata għal +25 % fuq il-pjattaforma kollha u qatt ma taffettwa klijenti li jirrepetu servizzi.

english: Payment is settled at the shop — the seat is blocked immediately.
translation: Il-ħlas isir fil-ħanut — is-siġġu jiġi mblukkat minnufih.

english: Type the name from the signed consent before booking this treatment.
translation: Ikteb l-isem mill-kunsens iffirmat qabel tibbukkja dan it-trattament.

english: Tip: click a free spot to add an appointment; click a booking to open it — details, phone, move, complete or cancel.
translation: Suġġeriment: ikklikkja post vojt biex iżżid appuntament; ikklikkja ibbukkjar biex tiftaħ — dettalji, telefon, ċaqlaq, temm jew ikkanċella.

english: Shown to customers on your shop page and in search. PNG/JPG, squared works best.
translation: Jidher lill-klijenti fuq il-paġna tal-ħanut tiegħek u fit-tfittxija. PNG/JPG, kwadru jaħdem l-aħjar.

english: Missing a category? Add your own
Running several salons? Add each location — they appear as one chain with separate calendars.
translation: Tmexxi diversi saluni? Żid kull post — jidhru bħala katina waħda b'kalendarji separati.

english: Demonstration project — no real payments or appointments.
translation: Proġett ta' dimostrazzjoni — l-ebda ħlasijiet jew appuntamenti reali.

english: Booked as a business? German bookkeeping systems ingest structured e-invoices (E-Rechnung). This downloads the same receipt as machine-readable XRechnung XML (EN 16931). Private customers don’t need this — the receipt above is your document either way.
translation: Ibbukkjat bħala negozju? Is-sistemi tal-kontabilità Ġermaniżi jieħdu e-fatturi strutturati (E-Rechnung). Dan jniżżel l-istess riċevuta bħala XML XRechnung li tinqara mill-magna (EN 16931). Il-klijenti privati ma jeħtieġuhx — ir-riċevuta ta' hawn fuq hija d-dokument tiegħek fi kwalunkwe każ.

english: Generated from this booking’s data and validated against the official KoSIT validator (XRechnung 3.0 rules + EN 16931). Demo notice: the salon data itself is demo data.
translation: Iġġenerat mid-data ta' dan l-ibbukkjar u vvalidat mal-validatur uffiċjali KoSIT (regoli XRechnung 3.0 + EN 16931). Avviż demo: id-data tas-salun innifsha hija data demo.

english: They’re on your bookings page — each can be moved or cancelled on its own.
translation: Qegħdin fuq il-paġna tal-ibbukkjar tiegħek — kull wieħed jista' jiġi mċaqlaq jew ikkanċellat waħdu.

english: Future visits are paid at the salon, visit by visit.
translation: Iż-żjarat futuri jitħallsu fis-salun, żjara b'żjara.

english: Tip (not part of the service price)
This receipt is issued by the salon. Keep it for expense claims — salons retain their copies for the statutory period.
translation: Din ir-riċevuta hija maħruġa mis-salun. Żommha għal talbiet ta' spejjeż — is-saluni jżommu l-kopji tagħhom għall-perjodu statutorju.

english: What your receipts say. The legal name and tax number appear on every customer receipt.
translation: Dak li jgħidu r-riċevuti tiegħek. L-isem legali u n-numru tat-taxxa jidhru fuq kull riċevuta tal-klijent.

english: Small business (§ 19 UStG) — receipts show no VAT, only the exemption note
translation: Negozju żgħir (§ 19 UStG) — ir-riċevuti ma juru l-ebda VAT, biss in-nota tal-eżenzjoni

english: That time was just taken — here is what’s still free
translation: Dak il-ħin ġie kemm kemm meħud — hawn dak li għadu vojt

english: These customers are already booked into this period. Hand each visit to a free colleague, or cancel it with a full refund.
translation: Dawn il-klijenti huma diġà ibbukkjati f'dan il-perjodu. Agħti kull żjara lil kollega liberu, jew ikkanċellaha b'rimborż sħiħ.
ai_review_note: cg_sub: 'kollega vojt' (empty colleague) changed to 'kollega liberu' (available).

english: Moved to {name} — the customer has been notified
That colleague just got booked — list refreshed
translation: Dak il-kollega kemm kemm ġie ibbukkjat — lista aġġornata

english: The shop is calling it off, so the customer pays nothing and gets everything back.
translation: Il-ħanut qed ikanċellah, għalhekk il-klijent ma jħallas xejn u jieħu kollox lura.

english: No messages with this customer yet. Say hello — a short note before an appointment is the cheapest way to stop a no-show.
translation: Għad m'hemm l-ebda messaġġ ma' dan il-klijent. Għid ħello — nota qasira qabel appuntament hija l-irħas mod biex twaqqaf no-show.

english: Replies are public on your shop page. Future customers read how you handle a bad day at least as closely as they read the rating.
translation: It-tweġibiet huma pubbliċi fuq il-paġna tal-ħanut tiegħek. Klijenti futuri jaqraw kif tittratta jum ħażin mill-inqas daqs kemm jaqraw il-klassifikazzjoni.

english: That time has just been taken
translation: Dak il-ħin kemm kemm ġie meħud

english: An offer shows on the customer’s bookings page for 30 minutes with that exact time. It doesn’t hold the seat — first come stays first served.
translation: Offerta tidher fuq il-paġna tal-ibbukkjar tal-klijent għal 30 minuta b'dak il-ħin eżatt. Ma żżommx is-siġġu — min jasal l-ewwel jiġi servit l-ewwel.

english: People who asked to be told when a day frees up. When a cancellation opens a slot, they are the first call to make.
translation: In-nies li talbu jiġu infurmati meta jum jitbattal. Meta kanċellazzjoni tiftaħ ħin, huma l-ewwel sejħa li għandek tagħmel.

english: Click a day to book time off for that person; click an existing absence to remove it. Bars show how full a working day already is.
translation: Ikklikkja jum biex tibbukkja leave għal dik il-persuna; ikklikkja assenza eżistenti biex tneħħiha. Il-bars juru kemm hu diġà mimli jum tax-xogħol.

english: An absence removes that person’s hours from the calendar, so no customer can book them while away.
translation: Assenza tneħħi s-sigħat ta' dik il-persuna mill-kalendarju, biex ebda klijent ma jista' jibbukkjaha waqt li tkun assenti.

english: Anything the shop should know? (allergies, wishes…)
translation: Xi ħaġa li l-ħanut għandu jkun jaf? (allerġiji, xewqat…)

english: No customers yet — they appear here as soon as someone books.
translation: Għad m'hemm l-ebda klijent — jidhru hawn hekk kif xi ħadd jibbukkja.

english: People are matched by phone number when they gave one, so the same customer stays one record across their phone, their laptop and the front desk. Private notes are yours alone — customers never see them.
